context_compression.fallback_policy: Deterministic compaction is used if Ollama is unreachable or alters finding anchors.

llm_rsi_evaluation.request_strategy: one high-level program-understanding request; three sequential whole-program findings-only RSI reviews, each rechecking the immediately preceding response; one separate compact metric-scoring request; Python applies metric weights
llm_rsi_evaluation.policy: RSI findings are validated independently of metric scoring. A scoring-schema failure cannot discard valid findings; missing LLM metric scores use deterministic analyzer fallbacks and are explicitly marked. A failed RSI pass is never described as proof that no defects exist.
